credit_required.notes: Credit Level: FAIR. No credit score required to apply (credit scores may be used if available).

rewards.redemption_notes: 1.5% cash back on every purchase, every day.

benefits.title: Refundable Security Deposit
benefits.description: $200 minimum refundable security deposit. Initial credit line of at least $200. Can raise credit line by depositing more (up to a maximum limit) before activating card. Maximum credit limit ranges from $1,000 to $3,000 based on creditworthiness.

benefits.title: Earn Back Deposit / Upgrade to Unsecured
benefits.description: With responsible card use, like making payments on time, you could earn back your deposit and upgrade to an unsecured Quicksilver card. Security deposit returned and account unsecured; all other card terms and features remain the same.

benefits.title: Reports to Three Major Credit Bureaus
benefits.description: Card status regularly reported to the three major credit bureaus.
